patches.name: Rambler App Context
patches.description: Shares active app name, input type, and field hint with Rambler so it adapts formatting (live toggle).

patches.name: Rambler Contact Names
patches.description: Auto-seeds up to 1,000 phone contacts into Rambler's voice dictionary when Contacts permission is granted.

patches.name: Rambler Cursor-Aware Editing
patches.description: Cursor-aware & selection-only voice edits, optional re-select after edit (off by default), and Append-only dictation.

patches.name: Rambler Custom Instructions
patches.description: Persistent default and per-app custom style rules, searchable app picker, disabled apps, and per-app behavior overrides.

patches.name: Rambler Personal Dictionary
patches.description: Live MUSE_STATS personal voice dictionary with add, .txt import/export, remove, and clear controls.

patches.name: Rambler Productivity Tools
patches.description: Long-press Spacebar trigger, Auto-Learn From Fixes (Beta), Smart Search Bars, Rambler toolbar button, Voice Send/Search, Snippets, Find & Replace, private Stats & History with 1-Tap Fix & Learn, Auto Retry, Longer Sessions, and JSON Backup.

patches.name: Rambler Waveform Animation
patches.description: Replaces Rambler's light bar with Hex Dot Scope / Android Wave (listening) and Flow / Pulse / Sweep (processing) animations, custom colors, and glow tuning.
